metadata.audit_scope: development-only; blind source audit; prompt pool, manifest-v4 and listed source pages only
metadata.example_numbering: 1-based source example order, including redirect examples; redirects themselves never valid operational examples
metadata.answerability_policy: All required behavior must be grounded in operational source examples for the target platform/shell. Explicitly compatible same-page option composition is supported and recorded. Unsupported requirements cannot be filled from external command knowledge.
metadata.valid_examples_policy: Examples directly satisfying requested operation, or necessary members of an explicit composition. Generic same-command invocation included when its target substitution yields the requested command; unrelated extra flags and partial neighboring operations excluded.
